mentions.name: Voxel physics multiplayer survival game
mentions.description: A multiplayer survival game built around voxel physics, combining an Astroneer-like setting, Teardown-style destructible voxel physics, and Valheim-like online multiplayer survival gameplay. The game has not been announced yet, but the developer has shared videos demonstrating the voxel destruction and gravity tech.
